run_visualize_dlrm_embeddings: run the DLRM visualization script with UMAP and T-SNE to analyze embedding tables and data representations for kaggle or terabyte datasets
run_analyze_model_data: run the analyze_model_data function to perform full embedding analysis, UMAP visualization, and categorical analysis on a trained DLRM model
run_visualize_embeddings_umap: run visualize_embeddings_umap to reduce and plot DLRM embedding table vectors using UMAP dimensionality reduction with configurable metrics
run_visualize_embeddings_tsne: run visualize_embeddings_tsne to reduce and plot DLRM embedding table vectors using T-SNE dimensionality reduction
run_analyse_categorical_counts: run analyse_categorical_counts to compute and plot frequency counts and embedding norms for each categorical variable in the training data
